daily.title: Daily puzzle
daily.alreadyText: Come back tomorrow for a new one, or keep sharp with Puzzle Rush.
daily.about: Everyone gets the same puzzle on the same date, and a new one at local midnight. Weekends are harder. Any attempt keeps your streak going.

rush.title: Puzzle Rush
rush.usedText: Free accounts get one Puzzle Rush a day. Coach Gold makes it unlimited, with history and leaderboards.
rush.endStrikes: Three strikes. Puzzles get harder the further you go.
rush.endTime: Time is up. Puzzles get harder the further you go.
